experiment: P6b class-specific temporal-query pooling for heterogeneous full-12 regression
research_question: Is the global average-pooled IQ-Grouped parameter vector the full-12 regression bottleneck, such that class-specific temporal query pooling improves parameter estimation beyond an equal-parameter/equal-main-compute global-query control?

reference_only.P1n: frozen reference-only classification/risk system; no P1n test predictions may be read
reference_only.P4c_P4d: heterogeneous MLCNN classification plus IQ-Grouped full-12 parameter route
reference_only.P6a_r1: stopped physical-FiLM path; descriptor, FFT cost settings and P6a identities are forbidden

single_changed_axis.C1: replace only the IQ-Grouped global parameter pooling/head with six learned class-specific temporal queries over the final fused IQ-Grouped map
single_changed_axis.C2: same IQ-Grouped temporal adapter, queries, per-class heads, parameter count and score-map compute as C1, but replace local softmax temporal pooling with global query modulation

training.parameter_loss: masked SmoothL1 only on label=1 AND parameter_mask=1 AND finite
training.threshold_calibration: per-class F1 grid on calibration only

stop_rule: If any validity or promotion gate fails, stop P6b on this identity pool. Do not alter query width, token adapter, softmax temperature, global-control formulation, loss weight, threshold, batch size or latency tolerance. Do not generate confirmation data.
next_if_pass: Freeze candidate/control checkpoints, normalizers, thresholds and code; run two untouched no-training/no-recalibration identity confirmations, then a five-model seed extension before any OOD, LSCO, long-tail or locked-test registration.
